# Runner protocol compatibility fixtures

`runner-v1.sha256` and `runner-v2.sha256` are SHA-256 hashes of the encoded
`FileDescriptorSet` values generated by the pinned build dependencies. They
make field-number, service-shape, and streaming changes explicit in review.

Do not refresh a hash for an incidental test failure. First confirm that the
protobuf change is additive for every supported peer generation, retain the
generation-one contract, update the structural assertions in `contract.rs`,
and record the compatibility decision in the protocol documentation.

The generation-two upload and typed-completion additions are additive service
methods and message types in the separate v2 package. Generation one remains
byte-for-byte frozen so old runners continue to use their original frame and
completion shapes during a rolling upgrade.
